description: Offline reference for MonoBehaviour and application callback order in a Unity frame. Authored fresh for OAC; verify ordering edge cases against the Unity execution-order manual for the editor version in use. Read-only, no Editor required.
notes: Order within a phase is not guaranteed between different components or GameObjects unless you set Script Execution Order.
Awake and OnEnable run once per object lifetime; Start runs once before the first Update after the object is enabled.
Use FixedUpdate for physics, Update for frame logic, and LateUpdate for cameras that follow moved objects.
Coroutines resume after Update and before LateUpdate for yield return null; WaitForEndOfFrame resumes after rendering.
OnValidate and Reset are Editor-only authoring callbacks, not part of the player frame.
